title: Marco Belinelli
wikitext:
'''Marco Stefano Belinelli''' (born [[March 25]], [[1986]]) is an [[Italy|Italian]] basketball player. He is 196 cm (6'5") tall and plays as a [[shooting guard]].

A native of [[San Giovanni in Persiceto]], he is currently playing for [[Fortitudo Bologna]] in the Italian [[Serie A (basketball)|Lega Basket]], and he is considered to be one of Italy's greatest basketball talents and future [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] player.

On several basketball scouting websites he is projected to be a first round pick in the [[2007 NBA Draft]].
